title: Ampersand Raises $15M to Connect AI Agents to Enterprise Software
summary:
Bessemer led a financing round for Ampersand to launch the general availability of its integration platform for AI agents. The company raised $15M in a Series A, bringing total funding to $20M, to help AI tools navigate the custom fields, permissions, and workflows of systems like Salesforce, SAP, NetSuite, and Workday. Ampersand currently provides this infrastructure for enterprise customers including Square, 11x, and Orb to prevent custom software deployments from requiring separate engineering projects.

The company is also releasing Andi, an AI integration agent, in beta after three years of development with its customer base. Ampersand will use the new capital to expand its coverage of Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems, build agentic integration infrastructure, and increase its number of forward-deployed experts.

selectedTweets.text:
Your AI is vaporware without deep integrations with your customers’ systems of record.

Introducing @WithAmpersand: integration infrastructure for enterprise agents.

We power 11x, Orb, and Square's ability to take agentic action in systems of record like Salesforce, SAP, NetSuite, and Workday.

Ask anyone serious about building AI and they’ll tell you:

- The SaaSpocalypse didn’t happen. The world depends on CRMs, ERPs, HRISs, and ITSMs.
- Your customers customized their deployments beyond recognition.
- Systems of record companies are basically monopolies. They never had to make their APIs and MCPs user-friendly.
- Docs don't explain half the weird edge cases you'll hit.
- One bad write can blow up your pilot or renewal.
- Once you finally get it working, someone changes a field and it breaks again.

The world's data lives in structured databases. AI needs a translation layer to work with it.

So, for your AI to truly transform the way enterprises work, you'll need deep integrations built for:
- scoped permissions
- bi-directional actions
- real-time speed for agents
- custom objects, fields, and workflows for each of your customers

We built Ampersand to power the future of software.

AI didn't trivialize writing integrations. It made them the critical path.

I believe that deeply, so I didn't make a launch video about Ampersand.

Instead, it's the best builders I know explaining just how big of a challenge this is.

selectedTweets.text:
AMPERSAND RAISES $15M TO HELP AI AGENTS WORK INSIDE ENTERPRISE SOFTWARE

Ampersand has raised a $15M Series A led by Bessemer, bringing total funding to $20M, as it makes its integration platform generally available.

The company helps AI agents connect to systems like Salesforce, NetSuite, SAP and Workday, where custom fields, permissions and workflows can make each customer deployment a separate engineering project.

The new funding will support broader ERP coverage, agentic integration infrastructure and more forward-deployed expertise.

Ampersand is also launching Andi, its AI integration agent, in beta after spending three years building alongside customers including 11x, Orb and Square.
